{"consolidated_memory":"Crash Loop Incidents in infra/k8s/deployment.yaml (Three Separate Occasions)

FIRST OCCASION [2026-03-05]:
- Component: infra/k8s/deployment.yaml (infrastructure side)
- Problem: Crash loop in the deployment
- Signal: Container restarting a few seconds after start
- Trigger: Deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- Root Cause: Off-by-one in the slice bound
- Fix: Corrected the bound and added a property test (PR #2068 on branch fix/crash-loop-1)
- Repro Method: Roll out to the small node pool
- Testing: YAML stack, covering check is manifest lint and dry run in CI
- Result: Nightly rollup matched the source counts for 80 days running

SECOND OCCASION [2026-03-27]:
- Component: infra/k8s/deployment.yaml (same corner of the file as the first incident; context carried over)
- Problem: Crash loop in the deployment
- Signal: Container restarting a few seconds after start
- Trigger: After a rolling restart of the fleet
- Root Cause: Schema drift between the migration and the model
- Fix: Regenerated the model from the migration and pinned the checksum (PR #4506 on branch fix/crash-loop-2)
- Repro Method: Roll out to the small node pool
- Testing: YAML stack
- Result: Throughput rose 84 percent, to 901 requests per second

THIRD OCCASION [2026-04-11]:
- Component: infra/k8s/deployment.yaml (infrastructure side)
- Problem: Crash loop in the deployment
- Signal: Container restarting a few seconds after start
- Trigger: For accounts in the five percent rollout bucket
- Root Cause: Floating point rounding in the money path
- Fix: Moved the arithmetic to integer minor units (PR #9179 on branch fix/crash-loop-3)
- Repro Method: Roll out to the small node pool
- Testing: YAML stack, covering check is manifest lint and dry run in CI
- Result: Job finished in 13 minutes instead of 6 hours

Summary: Three distinct crash loop issues in the same deployment manifest file, each triggered by different conditions and caused by different defects in different code paths (slice bounds, schema drift, and floating-point arithmetic), resolved with targeted fixes and property testing."}
